summary: Moon Studios' hand-painted metroidvania series; primary picks favor native PC editions for fidelity, while console and Switch releases are cataloged for platform completeness.

entries.title: Ori and the Blind Forest
entries.definitive_edition: Ori and the Blind Forest: Definitive Edition

emulation.notes: Native Windows build is preferred; Xbox and Switch emulation is unnecessary for the archive route.

primary.why: The Definitive Edition adds new areas, difficulty options, fast travel, and full backtracking; Windows is the most flexible high-fidelity native route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Ori and the Blind Forest: Definitive Edition on Windows through Steam, GOG, or the Microsoft/Xbox PC storefront at the display's native resolution.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release; Definitive Edition followed in 2016 with added content and PC display/configuration flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: best combination of added Definitive Edition content and native PC fidelity.

all_releases.fidelity: Original console release; Definitive Edition also released on Xbox One in 2016.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete console route, but Windows Definitive Edition is the more flexible fidelity target.
skip: valuable portable version, but no sourced exclusive story or gameplay content over the Windows Definitive Edition.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Windows Definitive Edition is both the most complete and the most configurable high-fidelity route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Play the Definitive Edition rather than the 2015 base release because it adds areas, difficulty options, fast travel, and full backtracking.

entries.title: Ori and the Will of the Wisps

primary.why: Windows is the native release with the broadest display/settings route; the Xbox Series X/S version is strong at 4K/120, but PC remains the flexible archive target.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows version through Steam or the Xbox app, using native resolution/high settings and a controller.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with configurable resolution and display settings.
all_releases.reason: primary: best flexible fidelity route with no sourced exclusive content missing from other versions.
skip: complete console route, but lower ceiling than Windows or Xbox Series X/S.
skip: portable route, but no sourced exclusive content over Windows.

all_releases.fidelity: Optimized console release with 4K Ultra HD and 120 FPS support on Xbox Series X/S.
all_releases.reason: skip: excellent console fidelity, but Windows remains the more configurable primary route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced exclusive content split across platforms; the primary choice is a fidelity/settings preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: Xbox Series X/S is a strong 4K/120 console option; choose Windows for the archive primary because it is the most flexible native route.
